Lifting at 78 is a good idea. Strength work is one of the best things anyone can do at that age, and people start well into their 80s and 90s. Whether it's safe for you specifically is a question for your doctor, especially if you have a heart condition, blood pressure issues, joint problems or take medication, so get their okay before you begin.

Once you have it, the approach is simple: start lighter than feels necessary, learn the movements first, and add weight slowly over weeks. Rest days between sessions matter more at this age. I can build you a beginner program around what your doctor clears, and I'll need to know how many days a week you want and where you'll train.
